skill.summary: Post and reply to X/Twitter and Farcaster with text and images. Features multi-account support, dynamic Twitter tier detection (Basic/Premium), auto-variation to avoid duplicate content detection, draft preview, character validation, threads, replies, and image uploads. Consumption-based pricing for X API, pay-per-cast for Farcaster.

latestVersion.changelog: Twitter tier detection (Basic/Premium), interactive threading, Farcaster GPG fix, multi-account support, reply functionality, auto-variation
